preset.parameter_basis: Pinned upstream Wan defaults; cached-layer fraction mapped by nearest integer

mapping.rule: Nearest integer to (28/40)*28=19.6, then lowest LTX foreground-attention ranks

generation.negative_prompt: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted

holdout.prompt: A fluffy orange cat walks across a sunlit room and gently brushes its tail against the leg of a wooden chair. A steady low camera follows the natural walking motion, with realistic fur and consistent warm light.

A woman in a blue jacket jogs at a relaxed pace along a riverside path. Her arms move naturally as the camera tracks smoothly from the side, with coherent proportions and detailed trees in soft daylight.

A close view of two hands slowly pouring clear water from a small glass pitcher into a ceramic cup on a wooden kitchen counter. The water stream and fingers remain visible throughout a continuous steady realistic shot.

A red tram moves slowly along rails past a row of old brick buildings. The camera stays steady at street level, showing smooth wheel motion and changing reflections in the windows under soft afternoon light.
A small white sailboat glides across a quiet lake while its sail shifts gently in the breeze. A steady shore camera shows the boat and its reflection moving continuously in soft morning light.
A man wearing a gray sweater carefully places three ripe tomatoes into a wicker basket on a kitchen table. A fixed medium camera keeps his hands and the basket visible in a continuous realistic shot.

A black and white border collie trots along a gravel garden path, carrying a yellow ball in its mouth. The camera follows smoothly from the side with consistent natural daylight and coherent leg motion.
A silver bicycle rolls slowly past a pale stone wall as a rider pedals at an even pace. A steady low side view shows the wheels, pedals and moving shadows throughout one uninterrupted realistic shot.

comparison_case.prompt: A fluffy orange cat walks across a sunlit room and gently brushes its tail against the leg of a wooden chair. A steady low camera follows the natural walking motion, with realistic fur and consistent warm light.

comparisons: One sequential 11-preset timing cohort plus native replay; 8 native/Profiling pairs

existing_mapping_reference.purpose: Output parity reference only, not a timing target

limitations: Official authors provide no LTX code or preset. This is a declared cross-model port.
Official generator scans layer lists; repository defaults are not authenticated paper-table parameters.
Offline foreground comes from Grounding DINO + SAM2 RGB masks, not the paper noise-PCA pipeline.
Fixed existing ranking aggregates valid records; 683/946 short and 24/32 long records are valid.
Calibration and restoration training involve VBench prompts; full VBench is not wholly unseen.
Previously inspected 8 cases are used without parameter selection, not a new independent test set.
Other accelerators keep their existing adapters and settings; this is a complete-system comparison.
